title: BLASTS FROM PLAYER 2 GO PAST THE SHIELD
why: The cloud review found that a shielded elite soaked the blasts of player 2 (his frags, his air strikes, his screen clear) but not the host blasts, which the design says go past a shield. The words player 2 sends for a blast now say so, and the host applies them past the shield and does not count them as a round that pins a pillager.
now: Player 2 blasts now go past a shield, as the host blasts do.

edits.anchor: if(el&&ELEM[el]) m.el=el;   // v23.xx (forge7): THE FORGE, the element of player 2's MK III round; the host applies it
edits.replacement:
if(el&&ELEM[el]) m.el=el;   // v23.xx (forge7): THE FORGE, the element of player 2's MK III round; the host applies it
  if(bl) m.bl=1;   // v26.xx (aip5): a blast (a frag, the air strike, the screen clear): the host sends it past a shield, as its own blasts go

edits.anchor: e.hp-=affixSoak(e,d); e.hitT=.16; e.pHitT=.3; e.pHitSeat=s; hitStopOn(e,d); suppHit(e);
edits.replacement: e.hp-=(m.bl===1)?d:affixSoak(e,d); e.hitT=.16; e.pHitT=.3; e.pHitSeat=s; hitStopOn(e,d); if(m.bl!==1) suppHit(e);   // v26.xx (aip5): a blast goes past the shield and is not a round that pins
